mintAuthority.summary: FRAX native mint authority is an AMO/governance hybrid on Ethereum only; immutable Ethereum token and AMO Minter contracts are controlled by the Frax Comptroller 3-of-5 Safe directly and through its two-day timelock. Other authored deployments are bridge representations and are assessed under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: FRAX AMO Minter
controls.capDescription: The AMO Minter can create FRAX only for approved AMOs within its aggregate 700,000,000 FRAX mint cap; owner or timelock governance can change that cap.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712139, owner() still returned the Frax Comptroller Safe, timelock_address() returned 0x8412ebf45bac1b340bbe8f318b928c466c4e39ca, and frax_mint_cap() remained 700,000,000 FRAX. The contract is the cap-limited mint route; only its owner or timelock can raise the cap.

controls.label: Frax Comptroller Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712139, the AMO Minter owner still resolved to this Safe and the configured timelock remained 0x8412ebf45bac1b340bbe8f318b928c466c4e39ca. Safe API returned the listed 3-of-5 owners, no enabled modules, zero guard and module guard, and Safe v1.3.0. The Safe can authorize AMOs and raise the 700 million FRAX cap directly through its owner path, bypassing the timelock.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712139, FRAX and AMO Minter remained direct non-proxy contracts on Ethereum, the only native issuance route retained in Mint Authority. Authored non-Ethereum deployments are bridge representations and are assessed under Bridge Risk. The AMO Minter retained a 700 million FRAX aggregate cap, owner Safe 0xb1748c79709f4ba2dd82834b8c82d4a505003f27, and timelock 0x8412ebf45bac1b340bbe8f318b928c466c4e39ca. The 3-of-5 owner Safe can authorize AMOs and raise the cap through the immediate owner path; Safe API reported no modules and zero guard/module guard. Current issuance is contract-governed and raiseable, with reconciliation not applicable to this on-chain AMO control model and no prudential supervisor. No public mint-authority incident was identified. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the immediate Safe owner path makes the cap economically unbounded, and repo evidence does not prove whole-supply reserve reconciliation across all deployments. Reconciliation determination 2026-08-15: the first-party Frax balance sheet (api.frax.finance/v2/frax/balance-sheet/latest) reconciles whole-supply liabilities (liability:remaining_frax_supply, borrowed-FRAX debt, FXB adjustments) against assets at pinned observation blocks on all 14 deployment chains including Polygon zkEVM and Fraxtal, refreshed continuously (asOfTimestamp 2026-08-15T19:23:47Z at review). AMO mints and satellite supply enter the liability side by construction, so no mint path escapes: reconciliation=continuous. Supervision stays none (self-published, no independent attestor).
